items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Pops' (Louis Armstrong) in the context of a third party ('he') learning from him. The interviewee (Hubert Laws) does not mention Louis Armstrong personally, nor does he claim any direct interaction or relationship with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, but that’s from the Bible. “Pamper one from his youth up, this one will become a spoiled person.” Now he’s seeing some of the stuff come true. He’s trying to tell me. I couldn’t explain it to him. Now he’s got his own kids. Now he’s bearing the brunt of it.
We saw he can bring the hammer down. So he learned something from Pops. That’s for sure.

Yeah, but sometimes I think he’s a little bit too stringent, when it comes to his kids. You have to have a good reason. There’s no reason for them not to take their little pup with them. That’s not going to hurt anything. There’s some other things that can hurt far worse than that. It wasn’t like she was stealing it. I think it was hers. I think it belonged to her, and she had left it here. She just wanted to take it back. But he’s over there at another place now. He just moved. He’s been here up until about a…
